thread:
rachel: Uploading the Nimbus Systems bundle for cloud marketplace listing + a tiny SI mini-case. Need checks on thumb, logos, alt text, and the customer quote legal ok. Files: https://drive.redwood/nimbus-marketplace/ (see thumbnails/ and assets/)

lucy: Thanks — sending to design for quick pass. Do we have a 1:1 and 2:1 thumbnail? marketplace requires 240x240 and 240x135.

kai: I exported svg + png variants. Names: `nimbus_thumb_240x240.png`, `nimbus_thumb_240x135.png`, `nimbus_logo_lockup.svg`, `nimbus_lockup_dark.svg`. Uploaded to `thumbnails/final/`.

sanjay: Customer quote: "Redwood cut inference costs 3x." — legal needs to confirm attribution and data. Also need quote source (who said it).

omar: @sanjay please provide full attribution + release form. I can approve if we have the customer's written OK. Without that, we need to anonymize the quote.

rachel: Sent the release pdf earlier today (see drive). If legal needs anything else, I can ping the customer.

omar: Found it, thanks. Two small asks: 1) change "3x" to "~3x" (minor accuracy), 2) include month/year of the metric. After that I'm good.

kai: Noted. Will update copy on the one-pager and regenerate the thumbnail overlay.

lucy: Design notes: dark lockup looks pixelated at 240x135 if flattened. Recommend using SVG for 1:1 and re-export at PNG with slight outline for contrast on light backgrounds.

kai: Will add 2px white stroke to logo when on dark photo backgrounds. Also generating alt text drafts.

brand-bot: Automated check: missing `logo_on_white.png` and `logo_on_dark.png` for marketplace packaging. Also flagged `nimbus_lockup_dark.svg` has embedded raster — request vector-only.

rachel: @kai can you add the two PNGs and re-save the SVG as vector-only?

kai: Yup. Added `logo_on_white.png` (500x500) and `logo_on_dark.png` (500x500). Re-saved SVG as vector-only and uploaded to `assets/logos/`.

lucy: Alt text drafts from design: 
`nimbus_thumb_240x135.png` alt: "Screenshot of Redwood + Nimbus Systems solution showing low-latency inference dashboard." 
`nimbus_logo_lockup.svg` alt: "Redwood Inference and Nimbus Systems horizontal logo lockup."

sanjay: For accessibility/legal, alt text should not claim benefits. Suggest tweaking first alt to: "Redwood and Nimbus Systems solution dashboard mockup."

kai: Updated alt texts and pushed to `assets/meta/alt-texts.txt`

rachel: Localization — marketing wants FR/DE for the marketplace listing. @sanjay do we have translated alt texts and the one-pager?

sanjay: Not yet. I'll coordinate with localization vendor. Timeline: 3 business days.

lucy: One more check: marketplace thumbnail must not include customer PII or logos without permission. We used generic dashboard UI and hex-blurred names.

rachel: Good. Omar, legal ok on anonymized screenshot + adjusted quote?

omar: Yes, once quote includes month/year and "~3x". Approve everything else including anonymized screenshot and SVG fixes.

rachel: Great — final ask: marketing wants a short subject line for marketplace tile. Draft options: "Low-latency inference with Nimbus" / "Reduce inference cost with Redwood + Nimbus" — vote with emoji.

lucy: :thumbsup: first 
kai: :thumbsup: first 
sanjay: :thumbsup: second (but fine with first)

rachel: Perfect. I'll publish tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone! (reacts :white_check_mark:)
